parsed.explanation: No documented trans-specific criminal offence, entry ban, facility exclusion, or police targeting of visitors. Everyday exposure is therefore low and anti-transphobia aggravation and penal discrimination grounds provide some recourse. The counterweight is documented, persistent serious violations in detention under the nationally applicable regime, with trans women placed by legal marker in practice in all-male facilities facing assault and a watchdog finding in 2021 with no documented remedy. That conditional custody exposure, plus absence of local evidence, keeps the combined regime in Elevated Risk despite the absence of criminalisation.

entry_documents.protection: National anti-discrimination provisions in penal code apply; no visitor document restriction documented.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented interaction between visitor documents and local screening.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Detention watchdog reported persistence of serious violations of transgender detainees' rights across all places of deprivation of liberty (2021, referrals since 2010 about 40 people). Trans women placed by legal marker, in practice typically in all-male facilities facing assault threats (2018 feature).
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Placement follows legal marker rather than anatomy, which may protect visitors whose home marker matches presentation; no documented effective remedy for violations.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: If a visitor were detained for an unrelated matter, this custody placement and violation record becomes operative; no local inspection or post-2021 follow-up is documented.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors; 2022 care report concerned residents, with waiting-time and access inequities.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific criminalisation or expression offence documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Discrimination on gender-identity ground in penal code since 2016; transphobic motive is an aggravating factor since 2017; stated as enabling prosecution of discrimination and transphobia.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Resident LGR without surgery, marriage equality and conversion-therapy ban are climate signals only and are not credited as visitor protections.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented for travelling minors or guardians.
minors_guardians.interaction: May 2024 senate bill banning medical transition under 18 was opposed by government, unlikely to pass, and unresolved after July 2024; this is resident care legislation, not a documented visitor rule.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Not documented for trans visitors; nationwide 2019 figure combines homophobic and transphobic victims without trans-only breakdown or denominator and is not used as prevalence evidence.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Transphobic aggravation for crimes since 2017 provides a legal recourse signal.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: No documented police targeting or failure to protect visitors.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No local inspection, follow-up, incident, or ordinance evidence; whether watchdog violations were remedied locally is unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Penal anti-discrimination and aggravation provisions are documented nationally, but their operation for visitors and in custody is not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Lack of documented custody remedy means the persistent-violations finding is not offset by paper protections.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar worst feature is birth/marker-based custody placement with assault risk and slow remedies, but this case is higher than 0.25 because no documented arrest trigger for presentation, no cross-dressing offence, and penal anti-discrimination/aggravation provisions exist. Custody harm still prevents a Reduced Risk rating.

Similar in that adverse outcomes are typically administrative or conditional rather than execution or routine imprisonment, with uncertainty and imperfect remedies. Lower than a pure administrative-friction case because the documented detention risk is serious violence, not only delay or refused admission.

This case is lower than 0.75: border or everyday detention is not documented as brief and reliably remedied, and unlike the anchor there is a watchdog finding of persistent serious custody violations without a documented working remedy.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime combines low everyday visitor exposure—no documented entry, facility, expression or police-targeting restrictions and some penal recourse for transphobic crime—with a severe conditional exposure if detained: marker-based placement in practice to all-male facilities, documented assault threats, and a 2021 watchdog finding of persistent serious violations with no documented remedy. Resident self-ID, marriage and care rules do not offset that custody practice. No local variation is documented, so the national framework governs throughout.
